name: Weeaboo Hotline
source:
It's the first day at art school a.k.a weeb school and you already run into trouble. Will you ever be able to fit in or will you end up turning your new friends into non-weebs?

[From[url=https://sasskurasaphicgames.itch.io/weeaboohotline] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是进入艺术学校的第一天，换句话说，也是进入二次元迷学校的第一天，你却已经惹上了麻烦。你究竟能融入这里，还是最终会把新朋友们都变成不再迷恋二次元的人？

[来源：[url=https://sasskurasaphicgames.itch.io/weeaboohotline] itch.io[/url]]
